newsitem.title: USA: McDermott names Tetrault its CEO.
newsitem.headline: McDermott names Tetrault its CEO.

text.p: McDermott International Inc said on Monday it named Roger Tetrault its vice chairman and chief executive, effective March 1.

Tetrault, currently a General Dynamics Corp senior vice president, will take the chief executive reins from James Dutt, McDermott's chairman. Dutt will remain chairman until August, when Tetrault takes over those duties as well.
Tetrault will also become chairman and chief executive of McDermott's majority-owned subsidiary, J. Ray McDermott SA.
Tetrault, 55, has been at General Dynamics since 1991, and currently is president of its Land Systems Division.
